### Key Virtuous CRM Customer Complaints

Based on aggregated user reviews and expert analyses from sources like SmartThoughts, G2 (215+ reviews), and Software Advice, here are the most frequently cited complaints about Virtuous CRM, a donor management platform for nonprofits. Complaints focus on usability limitations, support nuances, and scalability issues, despite praise for its intuitive interface and responsive support.

#### Top Complaints (Ranked by Frequency of Mentions)
| Complaint | Details & Examples | Sources |
|-----------|---------------------|---------|
| **Limited Form Customization & Design Issues** | Forms lack flexibility for collecting info/payments; not practical for quick/anonymous donations (e.g., no tap-to-pay); users want more customization options. Repeated in multiple G2 reviews (e.g., "I wish the forms were more customizable"). | G2 (multiple mentions, 2+ explicit cons) |
| **Query & Reporting Limitations** | Query functionality less flexible than competitors (e.g., Salesforce); steep learning curve for complex reporting/customization. | SmartThoughts |
| **Integration Challenges** | "All-in-one" claims overstated—relies on partner integrations (QuickBooks, DonorSearch, payment processors) that aren't fully native; issues with event management and seamless functionality. | SmartThoughts, G2 (2 mentions) |
| **Complexity for Small Organizations** | Onboarding costs and complexity overwhelm sub-$500K nonprofits; not ideal for very small teams. | SmartThoughts |
| **Support Response Times & Access** | 24-48 hour ticket resolution (no real-time chat like Bloomerang); some report no dedicated support, only generic tickets or bots (conflicting with praise for reps like "Aaron B."). | SmartThoughts, Software Advice, G2 |
| **Missing Features** | Lacks robust marketing tools; long estimated conversion times; custom setups sometimes unsupported (though support helps problem-solve). No quick anonymous donation process. | G2 |

#### Summary Insights
- **Most Common Theme**: Usability gaps in forms and customization (heavily echoed on G2).
- **Context**: Virtuous scores high on ease-of-use overall (intuitive UI, dedicated reps), but these pain points frustrate power users or small orgs. Feedback is often forwarded for development (e.g., tap-to-pay requests).
- **Positive Counterbalance**: 4.5-5 star averages on G2/Software Advice; support is "knowledgeable" but not instant.

For direct support, contact Virtuous at (866) 329-4009 or their [Help Center](https://support.virtuous.org/hc/en-us). More reviews at [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/virtuous-crm/reviews) or [SmartThoughts](https://www.smartthoughts.net/post/virtuous-crm-software-for-nonprofits-review).
